title: Unknotting orientable surfaces
summary: It is shown that every locally flatly embedded genus $g \in \{1,2\}$ surface in the $4$-sphere with knot group $\mathbb{Z}$ is unknotted. The same proof establishes that any two genus $g \in \{1,2\}$ surfaces in $D^4$ with knot group $\mathbb{Z}$ and common boundary an Alexander polynomial one knot are isotopic rel. boundary. In previous work, the author and Powell reduced such unknotting problems to a question concerning the cancellation of $(-t)$-quadratic forms over $\mathbb{Z}[t^{\pm 1}]$, which was solved in genus $g \geq 3$ using work of Bass.
